test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 4 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In which city of India did the East India Company set up their first trading center?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Surat**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sir Thomas Roe's **arrival in **Jahangir's court **was **a significant event **in **modern Indian history **as it was the **first step towards establishing **the **British East India Company **as a **paramount power **in the **Indian subcontinent**. 
 
• **In 1608**, the **British East India Company **decided to **open a factory in Surat**. The **English ambassador Captain Hawkins **arrived at **Jahangir’s Court **to **seek permission **for **trade with India**.
 
• The **East India Company **was an **English**, and **later British**, **joint-stock company founded in 1600**.
 
• It was **formed to trade **in **the Indian Ocean region**, **initially **with the **East Indies**, and **later with East Asia**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Initially, **it was turned down due to Portuguese intrigue**.
 
• The British thus **established their first (temporary) factory **at **Masulipatnam in 1611**.
 
• But, the **first permanent British factory **was **established at Surat in 1613**.
